# Photo-to-Zine Postcard Skill for Muse

Turns one user-supplied photograph into a minimal two-sided 2:3 zine-style postcard: the front embeds the original photo above a sparse editorial composition — a hand-drawn source-specific motif (chosen for distinctive identity and color, not ease of isolation), minimal metadata, and exactly three sampled color swatches — and the back is a matching functional postcard layout, all on warm off-white paper with a fixed portrait structure that never gets redesigned. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it designs through your agent's image generation — output quality depends on the image model, expect iteration; the source photo is preserved by rule (no stretching, repainting, or replacing); it's a design spec, not a print service — you handle printing yourself. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
